requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so classes A1 through A4, B and C are included. Turin location and the 850 sqm / 60-person capacity requirements are outside the available columns and are not filtered here.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided.

The property will be a university student residence, so schools and universities must be nearby. Set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) because the project depends on close access to education.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: property type 'Uffici e assimilabili', surface_area >= 850, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, education score >= 75, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). The 60-person capacity is not among the extracted requirements, so it is not filtered. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates, nearest first. Predicates are ordered from strictest to softest.
